item.title: Events, Groups and Classes - History
item.description: There many popular online events, groups and classes organised and publicised by our Journal team. Our seasons of “digital dialogues” have been running since autumn 2020. To date, over 15,000 attendees from over 110 countries have tuned in. For details of Events, Groups and Classes see: https://www.thephilosopher1923.org/events and The Philosopher’s Substack | Substack
